reasoning: **驗證目標**：Controls 頁籤之成員、分組、狀態顯示、各按鍵之狀態語意對照表。**為什麼這樣切**：一 leaf 一 TC（勘查 (g)：拆分 0）。**PENDING 二筆**：`014`（DR-VC9 之 `table above`）、`021`（DR-VC1 之 `PUXXXX`）。**未涵蓋**：Glove Box 之行為（屬 pilot）、Cabrio 與 Memory Seats 之內容（§8.4.2 委派）。

tcs.tc_title: Controls tab lists the eligible items
tcs.test_item:
CO2.) Possible items to be placed in the Controls tab include, but are not limited to (See table above): Headrest Fold, Auto dimming Mirror, Cargo Camera, Backup Camera, Surround View Camera, Rear View Camera, Eco, Drive Modes, Outlet, Sport, Settings, Screen Off (only shown if vehicle is not equipped with Screen Off hard control).

(Membership of the Controls list, stated by the source as open-ended)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with the Controls items under test
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Record the items listed in the Controls tab and compare them against PENDING: DR-VC9 Controls table reference
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The listed items include the eligible items the vehicle is equipped with
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：Controls 頁籤列出車輛所配備之可列入項目。**⚠ PENDING（IN §8.4.3）**：來源逐字含 `(See table above)`，而**執行層以 SYS1 實測**：§3 僅為章標題、其下無表；章 3 之唯一表在 **§3.9（本節之後方）**；章 2 之 §2.4 雖有表但其為頁籤名與位置，與 Controls 項目無關。**即 `above` 於規格自身即不成立** —— 不自行認定（§8.4.1），以 `PENDING: DR-VC9 Controls table reference` 佔位。**範圍**：來源明文 `include, but are not limited to` —— **非窮舉**，故只驗所列項目為有效成員，不驗排他（§8.4.2）。`Screen Off` 之 `(only shown if vehicle is not equipped with Screen Off hard control)` 為條件式，其條件已入 Pre-Condition 之配備敘述。**取材（R-VC25）**：上半取自 037 `Description`（優先序第 1）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 清單屬性：成員資格（對 -015 之分組、-016 之條件出現）

tcs.tc_title: Camera entries grouped together in Controls
tcs.test_item:
CO2.1) The Cargo Camera, Backup Camera, and Surround View Camera should be grouped together when you have two or more of these features within the controls menu.

(Grouping of the three camera entries when two or more are equipped)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with two or more of Cargo Camera, Backup Camera and Surround View Camera
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Record the position of the camera entries within the Controls menu
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The equipped camera entries are grouped together within the Controls menu
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：二個以上攝影機項目時，其於 Controls 內成組。**關鍵情境條件**：恰為「二個以上」之下界 —— 僅一個時無「成組」可言。**取材（R-VC25）**：上半取自 037 `Description`（優先序第 1）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 清單屬性：分組（對 -014 之成員資格）

tcs.tc_title: Settings appears in Controls only when substituted
tcs.test_item:
CO2.2.) Settings should only appear as a Control if the Settings Tab has been substituted with another tab.

(Conditional appearance, tied to the Settings tab being displaced)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The Settings tab has been substituted with another tab
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Record whether a Settings entry is present in the Controls list
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. A Settings entry is present in the Controls list
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：Settings 僅在其頁籤被替換時才出現為 Controls 項目。**關鍵情境條件**：頁籤已被替換 —— 未替換則不應出現，但來源只述替換之情形，**不驗其反面**（§8.4.2：來源未述者不造）。**取材（R-VC25）**：上半取自 037 `Description`（優先序第 1）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 清單屬性：條件式出現（對 -014 之常態成員）

tcs.tc_title: State changes shown on screen and in the status bar
tcs.test_item:
CO4.) Changes are indicated on the CONTROLS screen, and in the status bar where applicable.

(Two display surfaces for one state change, the status bar being conditional)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. A Controls item whose state can be changed is present
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Change the state of a Controls item
3. Record the CONTROLS screen and the status bar
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The state change is applied
3. The change is indicated on the CONTROLS screen, and in the status bar where applicable
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：狀態變更同時反映於 CONTROLS 畫面與（適用時）狀態列。**條件性成分**：`where applicable` 為來源明文 —— ER 保留該條件，**不主張狀態列恆顯示**（§8.4.2）。**取材（R-VC25）**：上半取自 037 `Description`（優先序第 1）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 顯示面：畫面與狀態列（單一狀態變更之二個表面）

tcs.tc_title: Settings shortcut available from the App drawer
tcs.test_item:
CO5.1.) A shortcut to settings is available from the App drawer.

(Reachability from the App drawer, an entry path outside Vehicle Category)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with the Vehicle Category feature
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the App drawer
2. Record whether a shortcut to settings is present and press it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The App drawer is displayed
2. A shortcut to settings is present and opens the settings
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **⚠ Pre-Condition 之更正（本輪自檢第 11 項所抓）**：前一版寫 `The App drawer is available on the head unit` —— **觸 §4.4 之二類禁項**：App drawer 為 HMI 之常駐介面（system defaults），且其開啟即本 TC 之步驟 1（step-controlled state）。已改為 feature initial state。 **驗證目標**：App drawer 提供 settings 之捷徑。**為什麼首步非 `ENTER_VC_TAB(Controls)`**：本 leaf 之進入路徑為 **App drawer**，非 Vehicle Category 頁籤 —— 取常數反而使該 TC 驗錯路徑。（同 `VC-001-02` 之情形：首步即受測動作之一部分。）**取材（R-VC25）**：上半取自 037 `Description`（優先序第 1）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 進入路徑：App drawer（對本批其餘之 Controls 頁籤）

tcs.tc_title: Headrest Fold button shows no status
tcs.test_item:
Headrest fold will not be able to show status, the user will simply be able to press the button.

(Absence of a status indication on the button itself)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with a Headrest Fold Controls item
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Record whether the Headrest Fold button shows any status indication
3. Press the Headrest Fold button and record the button behaviour
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The Headrest Fold button shows no status indication
3. The button accepts the press
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：Headrest Fold 按鍵不顯示狀態，僅可按壓。**為什麼這樣切**：本 leaf 擁有「無狀態顯示」；「按壓不高亮」屬 -019-02。**取材（R-VC25）**：上半取自 037 `Description`（優先序第 1）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 按鍵屬性：無狀態顯示（對 -019-02 之按壓不高亮）

tcs.tc_title: Headrest Fold button does not highlight
tcs.test_item:
CO7.) Headrest fold will not be able to show status, the user will simply be able to press the button. It will not highlight.

(Absence of a press highlight, distinct from the absence of status)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with a Headrest Fold Controls item
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Press the Headrest Fold button and record whether the button highlights
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The Headrest Fold button does not highlight
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：按壓 Headrest Fold 不產生高亮。**⚠ 上半取 SYS1 §3.4 之整段（CONT 表，指涉型）**：037 之 Description 逐字為 `It will not highlight.` —— 為完整句，但其主詞 `It` 之先行詞（`Headrest fold`）在 `-019-01`。單獨作為上半讀者不知 `It` 何指。依 R-VC7 取 SYS1 §3.4 之整段（一段二句），使指涉可解；**本 leaf 之驗證範圍以括號下半為準**。> 注意其與 `025-02` 之別：本筆取整段是為**資訊量**（讓 `It` 可讀），非因 Title 越界 —— 其 Title 為情境脈絡（R-VC24）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 按鍵屬性：按壓不高亮（對 -019-01 之無狀態顯示）

tcs.tc_title: Exhaust Sound status follows the system
tcs.test_item:
CO12.) Exhaust Sound Loud/Quiet status should follow the system status in the event the vehicle is equipped with a hard control.

(HMI status tracking the underlying system, on vehicles with a hard control)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with a hard control for Exhaust Sound
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Change the Exhaust Sound state using the hard control
3. Record the Loud/Quiet status shown on the HMI
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The system state changes
3. The HMI Loud/Quiet status follows the system status
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：配備實體控制時，HMI 之 Loud/Quiet 狀態跟隨系統狀態。**關鍵情境條件**：來源明文 `in the event the vehicle is equipped with a hard control` —— 未配備者不在範圍。**取材（R-VC25）**：上半取自 037 `Description`（優先序第 1）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 狀態來源：跟隨系統（實體控制之情形）

tcs.tc_title: Glove Box Lock opens the Privacy Lock popup
tcs.test_item:
CO13.) When the Glove Box Lock button is pressed, open PUXXXX (Privacy Lock). Refer to Glove Box Lock section for behavior.

(Popup launch from the Controls button, its own behaviour delegated)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with a Glove Box Lock Controls item
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Press the Glove Box Lock button
3. Record the popup that opens and compare its identifier against PENDING: DR-VC1 Privacy Lock popup ID
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The Glove Box Lock button accepts the press
3. The Privacy Lock popup opens
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：按下 Glove Box Lock 開啟 Privacy Lock 彈窗。**⚠ PENDING（IN §8.4.3）**：來源逐字為 `open PUXXXX (Privacy Lock)` —— **`PUXXXX` 於規格原文即為字面**，非實 id（DR-VC1）。不得代以語意相近者，以 `PENDING: DR-VC1 Privacy Lock popup ID` 佔位。**未涵蓋 —— §8.2.1 之委派**：來源明文 `Refer to Glove Box Lock section for behavior`。**Glove Box 之行為由 pilot 之 `026`~`033` 擁有**，本 TC 之 ER **不驗置物箱之啟用／停用／PIN 任何行為**，僅驗彈窗之開啟。**取材（R-VC25）**：上半取自 037 `Description`（優先序第 1）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 委派邊界：彈窗開啟（Glove Box 行為屬 pilot）

tcs.tc_title: Redundant content removed with a lower screen
tcs.test_item:
CO14.) For vehicles with a lower non-articulating screen, remove any redundant content from the HU that is displayed on the lower screen.

(Content removal on vehicles carrying a lower non-articulating screen)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with a lower non-articulating screen
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Record the content shown on the head unit and on the lower screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. Content that is displayed on the lower screen is not repeated on the head unit
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：配備下方非可動螢幕時，重複內容自主機移除。**取材（R-VC25）**：上半取自 037 `Description`（優先序第 1）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 配備條件：下方非可動螢幕

tcs.tc_title: Electrochromic returns to tinted each key cycle
tcs.test_item:
CO15.) Electrochromic state does not latch over key cycles and will return to “tinted”.

(State across a key cycle -- it does not latch)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with an Electrochromic Controls item
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Set Electrochromic to a state other than tinted
3. Perform a key cycle and record the Electrochromic state
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The Electrochromic state is changed
3. The state does not latch over the key cycle and returns to “tinted”
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：電控玻璃之狀態不跨鑰匙循環保留，回復為 tinted。**關鍵情境條件**：循環前須置於非 tinted —— 否則回復與否無法區辨。**記法**：來源之彎雙引號 `“tinted”` 依 R-VC23 逐字保留。**設計方法**：跨鑰匙循環之狀態轉換。**取材（R-VC25）**：上半取自 037 `Description`（優先序第 1）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 狀態面向：跨鑰匙循環之回復（對 -024 之即時不可用）

tcs.tc_title: Electrochromic greyed out when the roof is open
tcs.test_item:
CO15.1.) When the roof is open, Electrochromic is not available and the button is greyed out.

(Availability while the roof is open, shown by the greyed button)
tcs.pre_conditions:

2. The roof is open

2. Record the availability and appearance of the Electrochromic button
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. Electrochromic is not available and its button is greyed out
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：車頂開啟時電控玻璃不可用且按鍵灰化。**取材（R-VC25）**：上半取自 037 `Description`（優先序第 1）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 狀態面向：車頂開啟時之不可用（對 -023 之鑰匙循環）

tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：本 leaf 所載對照列之按鍵狀態語意。**表格取材（勘查 §3.7）**：值之權威為 **SYS1 §3.9 之二欄表**（`Button | Button Status`，28 資料列），037 之扁平化格僅為索引。**逐字引用整格，不自行拆分**；ER 逐列表述 —— 此為勘查 (g) 判其不拆之前提。 **⚠ 二處外部委派（§8.4.2）**：`Cabrio | Opens Cabrio pop up (see Cabrio requirements)` 與 `Memory Seats | Opens Memory Seats second level screen (see Virtual Memory Seats L&F)`。本 TC 之範圍**僅及於「按下該鈕後有對應之彈窗／次層畫面開啟」，不驗其內容**。**二者性質不同**：Cabrio 之標的（章 8／9）**在本 feature 內但 037 零涵蓋**（R-VC3 表 B 之 17 節，待 DR-VC3）；Memory Seats 之標的在**他 feature 之規格**且不在素材清單（R-VC10）。 **取材（R-VC25）**：上半取自 037 `Description`（優先序第 1）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 對照列範圍：Table rows for Bed Lowering, blind spot views, Electrochromic, Cabrio, Memory Seats and Ambient Lighting

tcs.tc_title: Controls button set matches the button table as a whole
tcs.test_item:
C1.) Controls Button Table.

(Whole-set layer -- the Controls button set as a whole against the button table, no table row missing and no button outside it)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle under test is equipped with the Controls features listed in the button table
tcs.input_test_data: The Controls Button Table of SYS1 section 3.9, whose rows are the 28 buttons from Rear Sunshade to Ambient Lighting
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Record every button that is present in the Controls tab
3. Compare the recorded set against the rows of the button table named in the test data
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The recorded set is the baseline for the comparison in step 3
3. Every table row whose Controls feature the vehicle is equipped with has a button present, and no button is present that the table does not name
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：Controls 按鈕之**全集**與 SYS1 §3.9 之 `Controls Button Table` 相符。**⚠ 本筆為 b 段，依 R-VC30 生成**（同 `007-01`，DR-VC9(二) 之查證維持發送）。**⚠ 與 sibling 之層次分工（IN §8.2.1）**：本筆為**全集層**（成員之完整性與排他性）；`-02`~`-05` 為**逐列層**（各按鈕之**狀態語意**，如 `Activates Feature`／`Off, On (if unavailable – greyed out)`）。**二者為不同驗證點** —— 每個按鈕之狀態都對而少一個按鈕，逐列層不會 FAIL，本筆會。**取材（profile §8 短來源）**：037 `Description` 為 `C1.) Controls Button Table.`，**27 字元**，上半取其完整句，須人工複核。**測試資料之表為實測**：SYS1 §3.9 之按鈕列實測為 **28 列**，自 `Rear Sunshade` 至 `Ambient Lighting`。**⚠ 範圍（§8.4.2）**：本筆不驗各按鈕之狀態語意（屬 `-02`~`-05`），亦不驗表外項目於他處之行為。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 表之層次：全集（對 -02～-05 之逐列狀態語意）
